subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: What privacy and authorization boundary should shared/private dashboard tabs provide for operators on the same Gateway?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether `visibility` is only a convenience filter or a stronger access-control guarantee, especially because current operator scopes are not intended as hostile multi-tenant isolation.

options.title: Keep As Security-Gated Roadmap Work
options.body: Keep this issue open and require store-level enforcement, UI filtering, migration coverage, and security review after the dashboard base lands.

options.title: Fold Into The Umbrella Tracker
options.body: Close this only if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 to own all Tier 3 dashboard planning without separate subissues.

options.title: Defer Outside Bundled Dashboard
options.body: Ask contributors to prove private/shared dashboard semantics in an external plugin or ClawHub package if maintainers do not want this in a bundled surface yet.

recommendation.title: Keep As Security-Gated Roadmap Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require store-level enforcement, UI filtering, migration coverage, and security review after the dashboard base lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that the dashboard roadmap builds on.
